source: Checklists of what a goal is actually made of.
note: SPEC.md Section 13 asks the Dream Calculator to become the shared Goal Costing Engine 'with a template library', and makes the Wedding calc structurally identical to it. These templates carry LINE-ITEM LABELS ONLY and no amounts. Costs are wildly regional and inventing them would put a fake number in front of someone planning a real thing; the value here is the reminder that the marriage licence, the survey fee and the travel insurance exist at all.
